author: GoPro
description:
We’re hyped to bring you a bonus look at GoPro Athlete @SammyCarlsonSki's film HARMONY. Sit back, relax and enjoy the top moments, unforgettable lines, and a deeper glimpse into what went down in Valdez.

"Every diehard skier and boarder knows the feeling of harmony in the mountains. It’s that moment when you step your boots into bindings and everything else clicks into place. You’re calm in the chaos. Your body and mind are one, your skis/board an extension of self and soul. All those years of honing your craft have come to this. But you don’t force it. Instead, the mountains set the rhythm, inviting you in, and you oblige and dance, It's these moments that keeps bringing us back, year after year." That’s harmony.

@SammyCarlsonSki isn’t just a force in Slopestyle and Big Air—he’s a six-time Skier of the Year and four-time X Games gold medalist. Watch the American freeskier bring style, power, and creativity to the Alaskan backcountry.

Filmed entirely at Black Ops Valdez Heli Skiing
title: "HARMONY" by Sammy Carlson | GoPro Movie
